def VTask.IsMinBadSeq {α : Type u_2} (r : α → α → Prop) (rk : α → ℕ) (s : Set α) (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → α) : Prop :=
  ∀ g : ℕ → α,
    (∀ i : ℕ, i < n → g i = f i) →
    (∃ k : ℕ, k ≥ n ∧ r (g n) (f n)) →
    rk (g n) ≤ rk (f n)
